notes_for_editor: Thin. The only source on the tower is one Forest Lookouts entry (county, forest, Removed). No build date, height, design, staffing or removal date found: not on NHLR or FFLOS (FFLOS lists only Handle, Lee and Troy for Mississippi), no NGS mark found, and one web search pass plus a second search used the budget. The story is about 80 words, below the 120-word target, on purpose. Map sites (getamap, Mapcarta) carry a 'Big Creek Lookout Tower' point in Wayne County; these came from search snippets only, were not read, and do not show whether anything remains. The record's coordinates (31.60025, -88.75985) were not checked against any source. Next steps: an NGS datasheet search for a Big Creek mark in Wayne County, and De Soto National Forest records.
